NOTE (published Tue 21 Jul; fieldwork 19-20 Jul, BEFORE Starmer's resignation) — YouGov/Times/Sky voting intention: Reform 23% (-1), Conservatives 21% (+2), Labour 20% (+1), Greens 14% (-1), Lib Dems 12% (-1), Restore Britain 3%, SNP 3%, Plaid 2%. First time Labour within margin of error of Reform since last July; first time Tories within MoE since April 2025. Backdrop context only (not a Wed development — fieldwork predates Burnham's premiership). Separate YouGov (June): Burnham net favourability c.-4 to -11; leads Farage 43-23 on "best PM" but only 32-28 vs Badenoch. Use cautiously and date-stamp; do NOT present as a post-Burnham poll.
